text:
maya: Uploaded new compact Autoscale panel mocks. Need quick decisions on guardrail tone, burst pill display, and keyboard behavior for pool picker. figma: https://figma.redwood/infer/autoscale/compact-v3

noah: Quick takes: 1) guardrail should feel advisory for self-serve. 'Recommended cap' wins. 2) Burst pill: show absolute GPUs by default, with muted percent below.

tara: Accessibility: current orange guardrail outline is borderline for AA on small text. Propose #8C4B00 and a 2px focus ring for keyboard. Also add aria-live region that announces slider changes: "Min X, Max Y, guardrail Z (recommended)".

oliver: Keyboard trap in pool picker is real. We virtualize list and accidentally swallow Tab. Fix = roving tabindex + Escape returns focus to the toggle. Also add tiny hint under control: "↑↓ preview • Enter select • Esc close".

maya: For burst pill adaptive rule: <=4 show absolute primary, 5-16 show absolute + muted percent, >16 show percent primary with muted absolute on hover. Agree?

noah: Sounds good. For copy: keep guardrail helper simple: "Helps keep latency within target; excess may be routed to fallback capacity." Avoid 'throttle'.

tara: Screen reader note: when guardrail value moves past the max, include a polite warning: "Guardrail is above max; scale may be limited." Use polite language.

oliver: UX microcopy for burst pill: line1 bold: "+2 GPUs" line2 muted: "(~+25%)". On mobile collapse to single line. Also track analytics: burst_pill_hover, guardrail_info_open.

maya: I'll update the figma and push frames with two copy variants (friendly vs strong) for a short click experiment. Will also add the keyboard hint and aria-live sample text.

a11y-bot: Filed ACC-4502: autoscale-guardrail-contrast + ACC-4503: pool-picker-keyboard. Links: https://tracker.redwood/ACC-4502 https://tracker.redwood/ACC-4503

tara: Once frames are updated I can validate voiceover and keyboard flow. Thanks folks.

maya: Thanks everyone 44d I'll tag eng once frames are in. Closing thread for now.
